_comment: License overrides for repos whose Hugging Face cardData is incomplete. 'fallbacks' fills a license (and commercial flag) from an upstream repo when a repackaged repo declares none. 'links' attaches an authoritative license URL (e.g. a GitHub LICENSE) to a repo that declares 'other' or otherwise lacks a usable license_link. Declared SPDX licenses are never changed; only empty licenses are filled, and license_url is supplemented/overridden by the link.
